title: The book nobody on Earth can read
hook: Nobody on Earth can read this six hundred year old book
summary: The Voynich manuscript, made in the early 1400s, is written in an unknown script that experts and codebreakers have never decoded.
sources: Yale Beinecke Library: MS 408, the Voynich manuscript, about 240 pages, vellum radiocarbon dated to the early 15th century
Encyclopaedia Britannica and Wikipedia: Voynich manuscript, bought by Wilfrid Voynich in 1912, unsolved despite attempts by codebreakers including William Friedman

lines.text: Nobody on Earth can read this six hundred year old book.
It has about two hundred forty pages of strange writing.
Carbon dating puts its pages in the early fourteen hundreds.
Dealer Wilfrid Voynich bought it in nineteen twelve, so it took his name.
Its drawings show plants that match no known species.
Famous codebreakers like William Friedman tried, and failed.
Is it a lost language, a secret code, or a hoax?
Nobody knows. It still sits unread in a Yale library.

post.caption:
A whole book, and not one word of it understood.
Do you think it is a code, a lost language or a hoax?
